title: Dispatcher selects a procedure
statement: Let the dispatcher for $n$ procedures occur at position $\mathrm{disp}$ in a word-RAM program of word size $W$, and suppose the code there begins with that dispatcher. If $r<n$, $2n<2^W$, the one-register contains the word encoding $1$, and the return-register contains the word encoding $r$, then after $2(r+1)$ machine steps the program counter is $r$ and the return-register contains the word encoding $-1$.
hypotheses_covered: Code at disp begins with the dispatcher for n procedures
Return-register contains the word encoding r
